headline: Video Editor and Motion Designer
summary: Video editor with four years cutting commercials, corporate videos and social content for brands in Cebu. I edit in Premiere Pro, animate titles and explainer graphics in After Effects, and clean up and mix audio. I help plan content from the concept stage so edits come together faster.

certifications.name: Adobe Certified Professional: Visual Effects and Motion Graphics

experience.title: Video Editor
bullets: Edit commercials, corporate videos and event highlights for about 30 clients a year.
Animate logos, lower thirds and short explainer sequences in After Effects.
Clean dialogue, balance music and mix final audio for broadcast and online.
Join concept meetings and storyboard sessions so shoots capture what the edit needs.

experience.title: Junior Video Editor
bullets: Cut short social videos and YouTube episodes for lifestyle clients.
Organised footage and project files for the senior editors.

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Multimedia Arts
education.school: Central Cebu College of Arts and Design
